correctness.rationale: Every right-branch iterate is an exact quarter-turn, the invariant unit square is checked on the switching boundary, all exterior paths hit the horizontal section within four iterations, and exterior section coordinates obey exact one- or three-iterate return maps. The scalar affine return recurrence completely proves finite capture, the period-three separator, and divergence. Explicit threshold ceiling formulae follow by solving affine inequalities, and the three two-sided critical crossover limits follow by elementary logarithm limits; the period-three multiplier is computed by exact Jacobian products. A rational checker corroborates but is not needed for proof.

value.rationale: The quarter-turn unit-determinant focus is a natural exact boundary of the repelling-focus Farey theory in the motivating article. A complete full-plane parameter classification, positive-area period-four core, transition to an exterior primitive three-cycle and open escape basin, plus three distinct exact capture-time scales and their explicit two-sided critical scaling functions are structurally relevant, not merely a numerical parameter example. The theorem is sharply qualified to one canonical rational-neutral slice and does not pretend generality across all rotations.
